title: Aromatic Light Kenyan Lamb Wrap
description: This dish is a mustardy and light Kenyan recipe featuring herbes-de-provence, ssam-wrap, and ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly ingredients, all cooked in a kadhai vessel.

ingredients.name: lamb shoulder
ingredients.notes: boneless and cut into small pieces

instructions: Heat the ghee in a kadhai over medium heat.
Add the mustard seeds and let them sizzle for a few seconds.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until they are browned on all sides.
Add the herbes-de-provence and stir well.
Cook for 10 minutes or until the lamb is cooked through.
Warm the ssam wrap pieces by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20 seconds.
Assemble the wrap by placing the lamb mixture onto a ssam wrap piece and topping with chopped cilantro.
